name: ARISE Summer Research Internship
org: University of Wisconsin Carbone Cancer Center
what_you_do: Interns work in a cancer research lab with a mentor, learn lab skills and do a project of their own. They also join career panels, pathology and outreach activities.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 and have finished sophomore year by the start of the program.
deadline_text: The summer 2027 window opens Jan 18, 2027. The page says it closes Feb 22, 2026, which cannot be right. Ask for the closing date.
how_to_apply: Apply online during the window. Have an unofficial transcript, two essays of up to 250 words each and one reference who is not family. Questions: education@cancer.wisc.edu.
notes: The page shows no apply link yet. Housing is not provided. A parent must come to orientation on June 8, 2027. Other jobs, camps or sports must not overlap. This is a different program from HERO.
